questions.stem: A bag has $6$ red and $4$ blue balls. Two are drawn without replacement. What is $P(\text{2nd is red}\,|\,\text{1st is red})$?
questions.explanation: Given the first ball drawn is red, there are now $5$ red and $4$ blue balls left ($9$ total). $P(\text{2nd red}\,|\,\text{1st red}) = \frac{5}{9}$.
